title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, bump actions and deps, optimize cache parallelism
author: Avery Patel
commits: consolidate: unify lint and test matrices into single workflow
ci: split release job to dedicated workflow with gated publish step
perf(ci): reduce build matrix by sharing cache key and enable parallelism tuning
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md to reference new CI workflows
description: Context: Over the past 18 months our CI workflow drifted into multiple overlapping GH Actions files with duplicated matrices and inconsistent cache keys. That increased CI minutes, slowed iteration, and made migration to Node 20 and newer actions harder. This PR consolidates lint/test/release pipelines into a clearer surface, bumps core GH Actions and setup versions, standardizes cache keys for faster cache hits, and introduces an explicit release workflow that gates publishing behind a manual approval and changelog check. Motivation: reduce CI variance, improve cache hit rate across repos, and make release automation safer and more auditable. Changes: - Consolidated lint and unit/integration test matrices into .github/workflows/ci.yml with job strategy: matrix.os, matrix.node_version, matrix.package_set. - Extracted publish/release steps to .github/workflows/release.yml with manual approval step and changelog validation. - Bumped actions/checkout to v4, actions/setup-node to v4, and several internal devDeps (eslint, mocha runner) to latest patch/minor compatible versions. - Introduced centralized cache-key-utils action to compute deterministic cache keys for node_modules and build caches. - Reduced parallelism in some heavy matrix axes and added dynamic concurrency tokens to avoid queue storms. - Small docs updates to CONTRIBUTING and .github/README to document new workflows. Testing and rollout: validated changes in redwood-examples and redwood-sdk-js via forked runs; observed ~18% average reduction in runtime for lint/test jobs and improved cache hit rate from ~62% to ~84% across sample runs. Rollout plan: merge to main, watch CI for 48 hours, then backfill analogous workflow in smaller repos and pin action versions in private deployments. Checklist: [x] unit tests passing in consolidated pipeline [x] lint fixed and autofixed where safe [x] release workflow dry-run tested [x] changelog validator added and tested [ ] coordinate rollouts for SDK repos (follow-up ticket). Related: Linear ENG-3421 (CI consolidation), ENG-5678 (release automation hygiene).
review_comments: Riley Chen: Nice consolidation. Two questions: 1) can we drop the node 12/14 entries from the matrix (I think only legacy operators need them)? 2) cache key helper seems useful — can we add a short unit test to cover the key generation?

Avery Patel (author): Good catch on node versions — removed 12/14 entries, left 16/18/20 to cover supported runtimes. Added a small Jest test for cache-key-utils and linked it in commit 3. Also updated the PR description with the test verification results.

Marisol Gomez: The release workflow looks safer with the manual gate, but ensure the changelog check does not block scheduled releases (we have a scheduled cadence for some customers). Could we add an override flag with audit log?

Avery Patel (author): Added docs entry and argument in release workflow for a required 'release-override' secret that still records the override in job output. Marked the flag as enterprise-only in CONTRIBUTING.

Ethan Park: CI run showed a flaky integration test on arm64 runner — suggests we keep arm64 in matrix but run fewer repeats. Also observed a transient npm install timeout; suggest bumping registry timeout and adding retry wrapper in ci-helpers.sh.
Avery Patel (author): Reduced arm64 repeats from 3 to 1 and added exponential-retry to npm install in ci-helpers.sh. Reran the CI and confirmed stability.
Riley Chen: Approving now that tests are stable and docs updated. Great work reducing complexity.
CI Bot: Full run passed after re-run (lint, unit, integration, e2e smoke, release dry-run).
release_notes: - Consolidate lint/test workflows into unified CI pipeline to reduce duplication and improve cache efficiency. - Extract release automation to dedicated workflow with manual approval and changelog validation. - Bump core GH Actions and node setup to supported versions. - Add deterministic cache key utility for improved cache hit rates. - Docs: update CONTRIBUTING and .github/README.
